description_en: Lists query executions and supports multiple filters
description_zh: 查询执行，支持多种过滤方式
name: ListExecutions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the template. This parameter supports fuzzy search. The operation returns executions of templates whose names contain the value you specify
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。名称未包含关系，最终列出包含所填模板名称的所有模板
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The status of the execution. Valid values: `Running`, `Started`, `Success`, `Failed`, `Waiting`, `Cancelled`, `Pending`, and `Skipped`
parameters.help_zh: 执行状态，取值范围：Running, Started, Success, Failed, Waiting, Cancelled, Pending, Skipped
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the execution
parameters.name: execution_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies a filter to return only executions that started at or before this time
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间小于等于指定时间的执行
parameters.name: start_date_before

parameters.help_en: Specifies a filter to return only executions that started at or after this time
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间大于等于指定时间的执行
parameters.name: start_date_after

parameters.help_en: Specifies a filter to return only executions that ended at or before this time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间小于等于指定时间的执行
parameters.name: end_date_before

parameters.help_en: Specifies a filter to return only executions that ended at or after this time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间大于等于指定时间的执行
parameters.name: end_date_after

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode. Valid values:

Automatic

Debug
parameters.help_zh:
执行模式。取值范围：
Automatic
Debug
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The user who started the execution
parameters.name: executed_by

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent execution
parameters.name: parent_execution_id

parameters.help_en: The RAM role
parameters.name: ram_role

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include child executions in the results. The default is False
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含子执行。默认为False
parameters.name: include_child_execution

parameters.help_en: The category of the template. Valid values: `Other`, `TimerTrigger`, `EventTrigger`, and `AlarmTrigger`
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The tags attached to the execution
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 100. The default is 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：10-100。默认为50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from a previous call that you can use to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The field to use for sorting the returned executions. Valid values:

StartDate (default): the time when the execution was created

EndDate: the end time of the execution

Status: the status of the execution
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值范围：

StartDate（默认值）：创建时间
EndDate：结束时间
Status：状态
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

Ascending: ascending order

Descending (default): descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：
Ascending：升序
Descending（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS resource
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource's template
parameters.name: resource_template_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the execution
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The level of execution data to return. Valid values: `RootDepth` and `FirstChildDepth`. `RootDepth` returns only parent executions. `FirstChildDepth` returns only first-level child executions. You can specify either this parameter or `IncludeChildExecution`, but not both. We recommend that you use `Depth`
parameters.help_zh:
执行的深度，可分为RootDepth、FirstChildDepth
RootDepth只返回主执行，FirstChildDepth只返回第一层的子执行。此参数和IncludeChildExecution参数只能同时传入一个，推荐使用Depth
parameters.name: depth

parameters.help_en: A list of template categories. Valid values: `Other`, `TimerTrigger`, `EventTrigger`, and `AlarmTrigger`. You can specify either this parameter or `Category`, but not both. We recommend that you use `Categories`
parameters.help_zh: 执行的模板类型列表。可分为Other、TimerTrigger、EventTrigger、AlarmTrigger。此参数和Category参数只能同时传入一个，推荐使用Categories
parameters.name: categories

parameters.help_en: The IDs of folders in Resource Directory. Use this parameter to query executions within specific folders
parameters.name: rd_folder_ids

parameters.help_en: 用户账户ID
parameters.name: account_id
